info.prompt: Bioluminescent blood drips from fractured gold filigree pipes into a baptismal font of swirling cyan liquid, where floating dice cast jagged magenta shadows across the cyber-gothic nave’s ribbed vaults, the shadows synchronizing with the stuttering heartbeat of a dying neural network whose last transmissions scroll upwards as burning terminal text across the chapel’s obsidian pillars before dissolving into the void-black edges of the frame.
